items.title: Papers: Blow for Man Utd as top target agrees new contract
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Tuesday's newspapers...

items.title: In the middle again - but Mourinho says Alexander-Arnold 'not a midfielder'
items.description: Trent Alexander-Arnold started in midfield for Real Madrid's win over Inter - but Jose Mourinho says it is not his best position.

items.title: EFL latest: Vardy's intelligence will help Burnley climb, says Hayen
Mbappe and Valverde on target as Real Madrid beat Inter Milan
West Ham go top of Championship - are they ready to leave past behind?
items.description: Three wins in a row, top of the table, unity at the club - are West Ham ready to leave the past behind on and off the pitch?

items.title: Bouaddi impresses on first start - have Man City found 'a gem'?
items.description: Ayyoub Bouaddi belies his age with a mature Champions League performance on his first Manchester City start to showcase why the club were so intent on signing the 18-year-old.

items.title: Haaland scores twice in win over Porto but Man City struggle to impress
items.description: Erling Haaland's double earned Manchester City a 2-0 win at FC Porto - but it was another game where Enzo Maresca's side won but struggled to convince.

items.title: Willock grabs late goal as Newcastle edge Millwall
items.description: Joe Willock's late goal sent a relieved Newcastle into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup as the Premier League side scraped to a 1-0 victory at Sky Bet Championship outfit Millwall.

items.title: Bowen at the double as West Ham climb top of the Championship
items.description: Captain Jarrod Bowen scored twice as West Ham's 3-2 win over Bolton took them top of the Sky Bet Championship on goal difference and earned a first ever win at the Toughsheet Community Stadium.

items.title: Delightful Talbi dink sees Sunderland past Hull
items.description: Chemsdine Talbi's goal was the difference as Sunderland claimed a 1-0 win over Hull in the third round of the Carabao Cup.

items.title: Christie nets hat-trick as Bournemouth blitz Championship Lincoln
items.description: Ryan Christie scored a hat-trick to give Marco Rose his first win as Bournemouth manager as the Cherries swept aside Sky Bet Championship side Lincoln 4-0.

items.title: Strand Larsen double sees Palace cruise into round four
items.description: Jorgen Strand Larsen struck twice to propel Crystal Palace into the fourth round of the Carabao Cup with a 3-0 victory over Middlesbrough at Selhurst Park.
